name: Civilizations
author: Agriche
description: Kingdoms evolve from the Paleolithic to the Omega Age, across 42 eras and over 6,000 technologies on six development paths (real-world, steam, Tesla-inspired, diesel, atomic and biological). Living politics with elections, parliaments, dynasties and revolutions; diplomacy with war goals, peace tables and coalitions; corporations, currencies, energy, trains, aircraft and an internet for NPCs; a round world with day and night. Then the Cosmos: a whole universe to colonize, alien civilizations, starship fleets, 84 megastructures and every scale playable as a map. Includes a sandbox catalog, a mode to rule one kingdom yourself, and sagas with choices.
